context.stage: Stage 1 — promote MUST requirements to TESTED

task.description:
Update requirement status and changelog after confirmed passing integration tests.

## 1. Read the test report

Read `tests/reports/WF02-stage1-integration-20260520-run-01.md`. For each requirement ID, confirm it has ≥1 passing (non-skipped) test before updating its status. Do NOT update a requirement to TESTED if its tests are still skipped or failed.

## 2. Update docs/status/requirement_status.json

For each MUST requirement with ≥1 confirmed passing integration test, update its entry:
- Set `status` to `TESTED`
- Set `test_run` to `WF02-stage1-integration-20260520-run-01.md`
- Set `tested_at` to today's ISO8601 date

If a MUST requirement does NOT have a passing test, leave its status unchanged and report it as an issue in the handoff result.

For SHOULD requirements (ES-07): apply the same rule — only update if tests pass.

## 3. Update CHANGELOG.md

Add an entry under the existing [Stage 1] section or prepend a new sub-entry:

```
### [Stage 1 — Integration Tests Verified] — 2026-05-20
- Real PostgreSQL client integrated (vendor/pg)
- Integration test harness (tests/integration/helpers.zig) implemented
- All Stage 1 MUST integration tests pass against bpm_test DB
- DB-01..DB-04, ES-01..ES-06, ES-08: status promoted to TESTED
```

## Acceptance criteria
- Only requirements with confirmed passing tests are updated to TESTED
- docs/status/requirement_status.json is consistent with the test report
- CHANGELOG.md updated
